# SDDRA — Specification-Driven Development & Reasoning Architecture

> SDDRA is a specification-driven development framework that makes AI agents
> understand project structure, dependencies, and execution flow. It is not a
> single product — it is a corpus of `.sdd` specs (custom DSL), a TypeScript
> runtime adapter (`sdd-adapter`), and a chain-driven execution model that routes
> prompts through docs → spec → code → review → deploy arms with human gates.
> This file is the canonical LLM entry point. It is generated from `.sdd/` by
> `/sdd-llm --export`. Do not hand-edit.

## Optional

- [SDDRA README](../README.md): project overview, install, quickstart
- [SDD Analysis](./analysis/system-analysis.md): how the .sdd corpus is structured
- [SDD Decisions](./decisions/INDEX.sdd): decision log (DEC-NNN)
- [SDD Tasks](./projects/sddra/tasks/INDEX.sdd): task registry (TASK-NNN)
- [SDD Phases](./projects/sddra/phases/INDEX.sdd): phase registry

## Core

- [SDD Index](./INDEX.sdd): primary entry point — route all reads through this
- [SDD Project](./PROJECT.sdd): project model, directories, authority
- [SDD Protocol](./protocol/ROOT.sdd): universal rules (PR1-PR9)
- [SDD Graph Model](./graph/model.sdd): entity/relationship/traceability model
- [SDD Chain Graph](./chains/graph.sdd): execution chain (D0 → arms → D0)
- [SDD Commands Index](./commands/INDEX.sdd): all /sdd* commands
- [SDD LLM Export](./llm/README.md): how LLMs and agents consume this layer
- [SDD LLM Context Pack](./llm/context-pack.json): machine index for tools
- [SDD LLM Entities](./llm/entities.jsonl): graph entities (JSONL)
- [SDD LLM Relations](./llm/relations.jsonl): graph relations (JSONL)
- [SDD LLM Graph](./llm/graph.json): compact graph view
- [SDD LLM Chain Map](./llm/chain-map.json): chains/arms/stages
- [SDD LLM Command Map](./llm/command-map.json): commands + usage + rules
- [SDD LLM Skill Map](./llm/skill-map.json): skills L1-L5
- [SDD LLM Rules](./llm/rules.json): extracted RXX rules
- [SDD LLM Chunks](./llm/chunks/): embedding-ready chunks with metadata
